rows.note: KNOWN GAP, unchanged by this work: the pre-existing prefix tier reads a name that OPENS a longer slug as the same brand decorated, which is what lets clark/clarkaudit through. Verified to behave identically on the deployed resolver, so it is a limitation to state rather than a regression to fix here; narrowing it would re-hold clark and carpe.
